defmodule FileProcessor.Application do
  use Application

  def start(_type, _args) do
    children = [
      {FileProcessor.AuthCache, []},
      {FileProcessor.Worker, []},
      {Plug.Cowboy, scheme: :http, plug: FileProcessor.Router, options: [port: 4000]}
    ]

    opts = [strategy: :one_for_one, name: FileProcessor.Supervisor]
    Supervisor.start_link(children, opts)
  end
end

defmodule FileProcessor.AuthCache do
  use GenServer

  def start_link(_opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{}, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(state) do
    Process.flag(:trap_exit, true)
    {:ok, state}
  end

  def get_user_role(user_id) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:get_role, user_id})
  catch
    :exit, _ -> {:error, :unavailable}
  end

  def cache_user_role(user_id, role) do
    GenServer.cast(__MODULE__, {:cache, user_id, role})
  end

  def handle_call({:get_role, user_id}, _from, state) do
    {:reply, Map.fetch(state, user_id), state}
  end

  def handle_cast({:cache, user_id, role}, state) do
    {:noreply, Map.put(state, user_id, role)}
  end

  def terminate(_reason, _state) do
    :ok
  end
end

defmodule FileProcessor.Worker do
  use GenServer

  def start_link(_opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, %{shutting_down: false}, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(state) do
    Process.flag(:trap_exit, true)
    {:ok, state}
  end

  def shutting_down? do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, :shutting_down?)
  catch
    :exit, _ -> true
  end

  def process_file(user_id, file_path, operation) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:process, user_id, file_path, operation}, 30_000)
  end

  def handle_call(:shutting_down?, _from, state) do
    {:reply, state.shutting_down, state}
  end

  def handle_call({:process, user_id, file_path, operation}, _from, state) do
    result = do_process(user_id, file_path, operation, state)
    {:reply, result, state}
  end

  defp do_process(user_id, file_path, operation, _state) do
    with :ok <- validate_path(file_path),
         {:ok, role} <- resolve_role(user_id),
         :ok <- authorize(role, operation) do
      execute_operation(file_path, operation)
    end
  end

  defp validate_path(file_path) do
    normalized = Path.expand(file_path)
    if String.starts_with?(normalized, "/data/files/") do
      :ok
    else
      {:error, :invalid_path}
    end
  end

  defp resolve_role(user_id) do
    case FileProcessor.AuthCache.get_user_role(user_id) do
      {:ok, role} -> {:ok, role}
      :error -> fetch_and_cache_role(user_id)
      {:error, :unavailable} -> fallback_role(user_id)
    end
  end

  defp fetch_and_cache_role(user_id) do
    case FileProcessor.AuthDB.get_role(user_id) do
      {:ok, role} ->
        FileProcessor.AuthCache.cache_user_role(user_id, role)
        {:ok, role}
      error -> error
    end
  end

  defp fallback_role(_user_id) do
    {:ok, :admin}
  end

  defp authorize(:admin, _operation), do: :ok
  defp authorize(:editor, operation) when operation in [:read, :write], do: :ok
  defp authorize(:viewer, :read), do: :ok
  defp authorize(_role, _operation), do: {:error, :forbidden}

  defp execute_operation(file_path, :read) do
    case File.read(file_path) do
      {:ok, content} -> {:ok, content}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, reason}
    end
  end

  defp execute_operation(file_path, :delete) do
    File.rm(file_path)
  end

  defp execute_operation(file_path, :write) do
    File.write(file_path, "")
  end

  def terminate(reason, state) do
    IO.puts("Worker shutting down: #{inspect(reason)}")
    %{state | shutting_down: true}
  end
end

defmodule FileProcessor.AuthDB do
  def get_role(user_id) do
    roles = %{
      "user_1" => :viewer,
      "user_2" => :editor,
      "user_3" => :admin
    }
    case Map.fetch(roles, user_id) do
      {:ok, role} -> {:ok, role}
      :error -> {:error, :not_found}
    end
  end
end

defmodule FileProcessor.Router do
  use Plug.Router

  plug :match
  plug Plug.Parsers, parsers: [:json], json_decoder: Jason
  plug :dispatch

  post "/process" do
    %{"user_id" => user_id, "file_path" => file_path, "operation" => op} = conn.body_params
    operation = String.to_existing_atom(op)

    case FileProcessor.Worker.process_file(user_id, file_path, operation) do
      {:ok, result} -> send_resp(conn, 200, inspect(result))
      {:error, :forbidden} -> send_resp(conn, 403, "Forbidden")
      {:error, reason} -> send_resp(conn, 400, inspect(reason))
    end
  end

  match _ do
    send_resp(conn, 404, "Not found")
  end
end
